post.title: Amway's average US seller made $750 in 2025. Here's why
post.ig:
Amway's average US seller made $750 in 2025, before expenses.

Amway's own US income disclosures: the average stayed between $723 and $852 from 2021 to 2025.
In 2025, 38% of US IBOs had no sales and got no payment; the top 10% of paid IBOs averaged $15,691.
Example: $750 minus the $55 renewal fee = $695, about $57.92 a month, before other costs.
A Sept 2024 FTC staff review of 70 MLM income disclosures found most participants made $1,000 or less a year.

Sources: Amway U.S. Income Disclosures 2021-2025, FTC staff report (Sept 2024), FTC proposed rules (Jan 2025).
